name: Stirling-PDF
description: #1 PDF Application on GitHub that lets you edit PDFs on any device anywhere
readmeExcerpt:
Stirling PDF - The Open-Source PDF Platform

Stirling PDF is a powerful, open-source PDF editing platform. Run it as a personal desktop app, in the browser, or deploy it on your own servers with a private API. Edit, sign, redact, convert, and automate PDFs without sending documents to external services.

## Key Capabilities - **Everywhere you work** - Desktop client, browser UI, and self-hosted server with a private API. - **50+ PDF tools** - Edit, merge, split, sign, redact, convert, OCR, compress, and more. - **Automation & workflows** - No-code pipelines direct in UI with APIs to process millions of PDFs. - **Enterprise‑grade** - SSO, auditing, and flexible on‑prem deployments. - **Developer platform** - REST APIs available for nearly all tools to integrate into your existing systems. - **Global UI** - Interface available in 40+ languages. For a full feature list, see the docs: **https://docs.stirlingpdf.com** ## Quick Start ```bash docker run -p 8080:8080 docker.stirlingpdf.com/stirlingtools/stirling-pdf ``` Then open: http://localhost:8080 For full installation options (including desktop and Kubernetes), see our [Documentation Guide](https://docs.stirlingpdf.com/#documentation-guide). ## Resources - [**Documentation**](https://docs.stirlingpdf.com) - [**Homepage**](https://stirling.com) - [**API Docs**](https://registry.scalar.com/@stirlingpdf/apis/stirling-pdf-processing-api/) - [**Server Plan & Enterprise**](https://docs.stirlingpdf.com/Paid-Offerings) ## Support - **Community**: [Discord](https://discord.gg/HYmhKj45pU) - **Bug Reports**: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/issues) ## Contributing We welcome contributions! Please see [CONTRIBUTING.md](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidelines. This project uses [Task](https://taskfile.dev/) as a unified command runner for all build, dev, and test commands. Run `task dev` to get started running the editor, run `task` to see the most common commands, or see the [Developer Guide](docs/developer/DeveloperGuide.md) for full details. For adding translations, see the [Translation Guide](docs/developer/HowToAddNewLanguage.md). ## License Stirling PDF is open-core. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for details.
readmeHtml:
Stirling PDF - The Open-Source PDF Platform

Stirling PDF is a powerful, open-source PDF editing platform. Run it as a personal desktop app, in the browser, or deploy it on your own servers with a private API. Edit, sign, redact, convert, and automate PDFs without sending documents to external services.

Key Capabilities

  • Everywhere you work - Desktop client, browser UI, and self-hosted server with a private API.
  • 50+ PDF tools - Edit, merge, split, sign, redact, convert, OCR, compress, and more.
  • Automation & workflows - No-code pipelines direct in UI with APIs to process millions of PDFs.
  • Enterprise‑grade - SSO, auditing, and flexible on‑prem deployments.
  • Developer platform - REST APIs available for nearly all tools to integrate into your existing systems.
  • Global UI - Interface available in 40+ languages.

For a full feature list, see the docs: https://docs.stirlingpdf.com

Quick Start

docker run -p 8080:8080 docker.stirlingpdf.com/stirlingtools/stirling-pdf

Then open: http://localhost:8080

For full installation options (including desktop and Kubernetes), see our Documentation Guide.

Resources

  • Documentation
  • Homepage
  • API Docs
  • Server Plan & Enterprise

Support

  • Community: Discord
  • Bug Reports: GitHub Issues

Contributing

We welcome contributions! Please see CONTRIBUTING.md for guidelines.

This project uses Task as a unified command runner for all build, dev, and test commands. Run task dev to get started running the editor, run task to see the most common commands, or see the Developer Guide for full details.

For adding translations, see the Translation Guide.

License

Stirling PDF is open-core. See LICENSE for details.

releases.name: 3.1.0 Stirling Sign, signature improvements, Stirling Office Convert (beta) and text editor upgrades
releases.body:
Some big changes in this release yet again!
Group signing (Called Stirling Sign) is moving out of alpha and is now being enabled by default for new users, with it, you can share, track, and sign PDFs across your org. It also comes with a brand new sign UI, drastically improving the user experience of signing. Please let us know if you have any issues with it!

We are also shipping a new embedded conversion tool called "Stirling Office Convert" which we are trialing, It aims to give better conversion results faster and with less memory. This is a beta, so please compare and let us know! (Enable it by default under Advanced > Feature Flags)

We have a ton of other features in this release:

- Text editor supports editing tables directly in file!
- Text editor supports editing OCRed image PDFs! 
- Text editor UI and UX improvements
- Attachments Support improvements (Add, rename, extract, delete etc)
- Several Dependency updates

And to mention again: 
- Brand new Group signing UI 
- New PDF conversion tool, hopefully to replace the old tool in the future (and coming to native desktop soon!) 
- Sign tool improvements

releases.name: 3.0.2 bug fixes and dependency updates
releases.body:
This release contains bug fixes and various other improvements
Enhancements:
- add support for selective page cropping
- better tool recommendation based on user usage
- add visual feedback during page reordering 

Bugs fixed:
- translations missing
- Certain languages not loading correctly
- Processor not correctly loading in certain versions of the app
- latest-fat having file upload issues
- Default mode as viewer/reader not correctly working


## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes
* fix: resolve i18n template placeholders in settings search results by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/6814
### Enhancements
* Re-enable typed linting and ban unnecessary type assertions by @jbrunton96 in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8178
* enable local tool usage tracking by @Frooodle in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8207
* Add limit to max depth for JSX by @jbrunton96 in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8180
* feat(crop): add support for selective page cropping by @balazs-szucs in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/7753
* Update zh-TW Traditional Chinese locale by @Peter

releases.name: 3.0.0 PDF Processor, Brand new text editor, Free OAuth and tons of new features
releases.body:
Stirling PDF V3.0 is live!
With this update we are introducing a lot of exciting new changes, A brand new automation system, Free OAuth SSO for all, brand new text editor and a ton of new features, bug fixes and security fixes

We have a new system along side the "PDF Editor" called the "PDF Processor"
The PDF Processor takes the tools you already use in Stirling PDF and lets you run them across a large numbers of files with a variety of sources (Folders/FTP/S3 etc)
The idea is, If you need to OCR 10,000 files, Compress a whole folder or convert a whole document library this should be a tool which can help with that and allow it to listen and run for future files as they arrive
This is the first major release of Processor and we will be improving it quickly based on how people use it.
[Full Processor guide with examples](https://docs.stirlingpdf.com/Processor/)
AI is also available as an optional part of Processor.
You can use AI to understand documents, classify them, extract information, and help automate processing. AI is fully optional (and off by default) and can use various models including locally/self-hosted models depending on your setup.

releases.name: 2.14.3 lots of bug fixes
releases.body:
Hotfix release for lots of bug fixes, 
(Note we have identified some issues for mac users and hope to have another fix out in next few days)
The list below is of the main bug fixes are:

## Tool fixes
- fix merge split and other operations not working on Debian 12 and fedora 44
- Concurrent usage issues on certain tools like merge 
- Automate issues for remove images fixed
- Large 2GB PDFs no longer crashes under set scenarios 

## Desktop fixes
- Windows ARM64 test build
- linux startup fixes

We are planning a giant release in 2-3 weeks with some big exciting new features so keep on the lookout!


## What's Changed

* Redact: clear error instead of a 500 when no text patterns are given (cherrypicked) by @jbrunton96 in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/6972
* fix(temp-files): prevent cleanup of active registered directories by @Ludy87 in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/7006
* deps(frontend): upgrade @embedpdf packages to v2.14.4 by @Ludy87 in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/6989
* fix(admin-settings): correctly mask Telegram bot tokens in settings output by @Ludy87 in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/

aiSummary.oneLiner: A comprehensive, self-hosted open-source platform offering deep PDF manipulation and conversion tools without externa...
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Stirling PDF is a highly capable open-source document manipulation platform that empowers users to perform comprehensive edits, conversions, and automation on PDF files locally. It operates primarily as a Dockerized web application, ensuring sensitive documents are fully processed locally without ever pinging external cloud services for heightened data security. The platform consolidates a massive array of utilities, allowing users to effortlessly merge, split, OCR, digitally sign, and deeply redact dense multi-page documents directly from their browser. By exposing a completely private internal API, developers can also seamlessly integrate complex PDF processing routines into their own self-hosted automation pipelines.
keyFeatures: Total Privacy: Ensures all document processing, OCR, and redaction happens completely locally on your hardware without external API calls.
Comprehensive Editing Toolset: Enables deep structural changes to files including merging, splitting, signing, and granular page reordering.
Advanced OCR Integration: Converts scanned images into fully searchable and selectable text documents seamlessly using localized processing.
Private Developer API: Exposes a comprehensive local web API allowing complex PDF transformation routines to be automated securely.
Multi-Environment Deployment: Supports running natively as a desktop application, directly in the browser, or as a self-hosted Docker container.
Extensive Format Conversion: Converts documents fluidly back and forth between PDF and numerous image, word, or structured text formats.

useCases.title: Secure Document Redaction
useCases.description: Legal professionals utilize the platform to completely locally redact sensitive personal information from case files without trusting cloud converters.

useCases.title: Automated OCR Pipelines
useCases.description: Developers deploy the Docker container to automatically ingest and parse incoming physical scans using the exposed local API.

useCases.title: Enterprise Document Standardization
useCases.description: IT departments host the application internally to provide all staff with a robust, highly secure unified PDF editor.

useCases.title: Rapid Batch Processing
useCases.description: Archivists utilize the comprehensive merging and splitting tools to organize and rapidly catalog massive historical document libraries offline.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Privacy-conscious individuals, enterprises, and developers who need a powerful, fully locally-hosted solution for managing and editing PDF files securely. It is suitable for professionals looking for efficiency.
